# Witness Submission Guide

External witnesses may submit bounded feedback about a specific artifact,
fixture, source docket, method docket, or replay command.

A witness submission should include:

- reviewer identity or pseudonymous key
- scope
- artifact hash
- command run
- pass/fail result
- limitations
- whether the reviewer claims any authority, and if so the bounded scope

External witnesses cannot upgrade Parva outputs into official authority by
assertion alone.
